categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in construction and civil engineering contracting, mechanical and electrical installation, precast concrete production and sales, cement and mortar materials production, interior decoration design, and consulting services. It also handles distribution and import-export of construction materials and equipment. Major projects include residential buildings, office buildings, high-tech factories, and public infrastructure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on precast concrete technologies, including patented methods such as precast layered, lattice slab, and seismic isolation layer techniques. It integrates design, manufacturing, and construction with AI and BIM applications, emphasizing modularization, standardization, and industrial engineering to improve quality and efficiency. It also develops new construction machinery and sustainable low-carbon building methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies for public housing and infrastructure, high-tech companies for factory construction, real estate developers for residential and commercial buildings, and insurance companies. The company serves markets primarily in Taiwan, focusing on large-scale construction projects requiring high quality and precision.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with projects distributed across northern, central, and southern regions including Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan, Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan, and Kaohsiung. The company does not report significant overseas operations but aims to expand market share domestically.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, providing integrated design-build services, precast component manufacturing, and construction execution. It also acts as a general contractor managing subcontractors and suppliers, with some upstream involvement through its investment in material production subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing employee training, advancing AI and automation in construction, expanding precast and design-build capabilities, and integrating BIM and mechanical-electrical systems. R&D focuses on sustainable low-carbon construction, innovative precast technologies, and improving construction efficiency and quality. The company also emphasizes ESG and sustainability governance.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering contract income from construction projects, supplemented by product sales of precast concrete and building materials. Additional income comes from consulting and technical services. The company uses cost-plus pricing for contracts to mitigate raw material price volatility.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading quality-focused construction firm in Taiwan with strong innovation capabilities and integrated service offerings. It competes in a fragmented market with many small firms, leveraging patented technologies and comprehensive project management to differentiate itself. It holds a modest market share (~0.6%) in Taiwan's construction industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$26.2 billion in 2024, a 16.6% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to owners rising 45.8% to NT$2.77 billion. It has shown steady growth supported by large-scale projects and improved profitability. Total assets reached NT$24.5 billion with equity of NT$8.8 billion, reflecting a solid financial position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality construction with integrated design, manufacturing, and construction services supported by patented precast technologies and AI-driven project management. Its value proposition includes faster construction times, cost savings through modularization and automation, superior quality control, and sustainable building practices aligned with ESG goals. This comprehensive approach aims to maximize customer satisfaction and shareholder value.
